name: Student Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires full-time enrollment at a recognised institution of higher education or accredited institute, pursuing a diploma, postgraduate diploma, doctorate, or other higher-education qualification.
Requires sufficient financial resources for living expenses and health insurance.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial means and health insurance
Medical examination within 10 days of arrival, police registration

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable (renewal application due 1 month before expiry)

sources.title: European Commission EU Immigration Portal -- Student, Cyprus

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build. work_rights 'restricted': up to 20 hours/week in designated sectors (domestic activities, waste management, restaurants, recreation centres, cleaning services), with the employment contract certified by the Department of Labour -- a narrower list of permitted sectors than typical for student work rights elsewhere in this dataset. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: sourced only via the EU's own immigration portal (tier 2, intergovernmental per this dataset's convention), since gov.cy's Migration Department pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching throughout this pass; the EU portal itself states it reflects Cyprus's national transposition, so the substance should be reliable, but a tier-1 (.gov.cy) confirmation was not achieved in this pass. Time on this permit explicitly does NOT count toward cy_long_term_residence's 5-year residence test, per that route's own sourcing -- a materially important exclusion, flagged rather than assumed away.
